voices: Local eSpeak NG synthetic speech, no human likeness

dialogue.arrival: Cloudrest valley. The mountain remembers. Find Mei beneath the lanterns.
dialogue.mei: You carry his sword. Then you survived the fire. Bring me three moon lotus. Their roots remember clean water.
dialogue.shen: Three wardens hold the seals. Restore their altars. Qi is power. What you do with it is cultivation.
dialogue.lan: At the summit, you may sever the binding, or inherit it. The mountain will remember your choice.
dialogue.seals: The three meridians breathe again. Immortal Xu waits at the ruined pagoda.
dialogue.xu: I only wanted to hear her laugh again. Tell me, cultivator. Was that too much to ask of heaven?
